mass_source: Assumption: no sourced curb weight for the 1891 car; wooden chassis, front V-twin, three-speed gearbox, iron-hubbed artillery wheels.

steering_servo.note: Driver's grip on the tiller (0.30 m arm: 60 N m is 200 N at the grip).

tire.note: Solid rubber tyre: round crown (ellipsoid) with direct contact stiffness and damping per unit mass (MuJoCo solref -k -b: k 2300 s^-2, b 48 s^-1, about 6 Hz body bounce at damping ratio 0.5) and an impedance that builds over 10 mm of deflection (solimp 0.5-0.95). Static sag is about 1-1.5 mm. The earlier 0.02 s time-constant contact sagged only 0.1 mm (effectively rigid) and let tyre loads jitter at ~95 Hz in powered turns (up to 77% on a wheel); with this setting the worst wheel varies 1.5%. Flat stiff cylinders chattered before that.

assumptions: Mass split, centre of mass (front engine, behind the front axle) and inertia are estimates; no occupants.
